data.content: Upon entering the Kosovar market, the Austrian brick producing giant, Xella, selected us to produce, organize and design all of its communication and promotional needs.
During our cooperation, we produced a large number of publications and other designed materials, strictly following the company's brand image rules.
These included catalogues, brochures, flyers, leaflets, posters, banners, as well as smaller promotional materials, gifts, etc.

A brick made by Xella is in many ways positively different from the usual brick. It is friendlier to the environment, a better sound isolator, water and thermal resistant, made with European standards, space saver, and, above all, stronger than any other brick.

We were asked to produce a low budget TV campaign to present all of the above qualities of a Xella brick. Being quite impossible to do so in a single commercial successfully, we decided to produce 6 short TV ads, with the brick as the main character, handling different situations.
We organized the grand opening event of the factory in Kosova at the actual facilities, in order to show guests the capacities of the factory.

The main part of the event was held in the large yard outside a factory, which is located near the town of Lypjan, about 15 km from Prishtina. We organized the catering, transport and entertainment for over 500 invited people, with a stage set up for music and speeches.
The ribbon was cut by then the President of the Republic of Kosova, and an introduction tour throughout the factory was held for all the guests.
